Image crop and fill semantics. [#6954] The two banners are fine-detail rasters stretched into their frames, so the whole budget is inter-backend resampling: devel measured 0.01966 against a 0.02 budget (98.3% of it). Once both backends stopped cropping the source (they now agree within 1px of ink bbox) the 1:1 draw is sharper and the same resampling noise measures 0.02170. Raised to 0.03 with that headroom; table-core (0.047) and paragraph-line-basic (0.03) are tuned the same way.
